column5: ported;note:each && chain becomes an ASSERT guard (section found, one entry, one word) followed by one EXPECT, so the CBB, CD and KHV facts are checked independently

merged:Patchset.test_malformed_patchsets_fail_without_partial_output.TruncatedAddress;note:its loop over five malformed byte strings is TEST_P PatchsetMalformed.FailsWithoutPartialOutput with rows TruncatedAddress, TruncatedLength, TruncatedPatchWord, TruncatedSectionDelimiter and PartialSecondSection (same bytes, built with test::append_be32), bundled as objects.Row/PatchsetMalformed; the parse refusal is an ASSERT before the merge checks and every row runs instead of stopping at the first failure
ported;note:the two refusals are independent facts, so the early return after the first becomes two EXPECTs
